meta.title: Remove unused code across Helper monorepo
meta.body_summary: Remove unused code and dependencies across Helper monorepo based on knip analysis, deleting 24 files, removing 37 dependencies, reducing bundle size and maintenance overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Devin ran knip to remove unused code but included docker/tmp runtime files and build artifacts, leading to immediate closure; cursor bot flagged redis manifest issue post-close.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2247 changed lines across 40 files, this is a large-scale code removal by absolute volume. It was closed immediately, consistent with the invalid inclusion of unintended runtime files and build artifacts that made the PR unsafe to merge.

review_details.concern_detail: The PR erroneously included docker/tmp/redis runtime data files and binary artifacts (e.g., apps/nextjs/public/sdk*.js, local-nginx certs) that should not be committed, as flagged by the cursor bot post-close.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce bundle size and build overhead by removing unused code and dependencies.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed within 2 minutes by maintainer with no comment; cursor bot flagged redis manifest file post-close, reinforcing the issue of unintended file inclusion.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin completed a large-scale code removal but failed to exclude runtime-generated files and build artifacts from the commit, indicating boundary in understanding repository conventions and what not to commit.

detection_detail.code_reading: The maintainer likely inspected the PR diff and noticed the unintended addition of docker/tmp runtime files and build artifacts, prompting immediate closure.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks or before/after metrics provided; the removal was based solely on knip static analysis.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without any fix cycle; the inclusion of erroneous files made it unmergeable.

core_change_summary.description: Single commit removed 24 files (db setup scripts, tests, UI components, scripts) and 37 dependencies from package.json files, but also inadvertently added docker/tmp/redis runtime files, local-nginx certificates, and frontend build artifacts (sdk.js, etc.).
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The commit also added runtime-generated files that should not be versioned, undermining the cleanup purpose.
change_trajectory: Single commit removing unused code and dependencies, with unintended addition of runtime and build files.

review_signals.summary: Cursor bot flagged that docker/tmp/redis/appendonlydir/appendonly.aof.manifest is a runtime file that should not be committed.

collaboration_trajectory: Single commit by Devin with removal and unintended adds.
PR created and automatically received bot comments from Devin, CodeRabbit, and Supabase.
Maintainer closed PR within 2 minutes without merge or comment.
Cursor bot posted review comment about redis manifest file after closure.
